# SAMHSA (Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration)

> > The U.S. government's leading agency for behavioral health, providing evidence-based resources, data collections, crisis services (988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline), treatment locators (FindTreatment.gov), and grant funding for substance use and mental health programs nationwide.

SAMHSA advances behavioral health through national surveys (NSDUH, MH-CLD), evidence-based practice guidelines, recovery support programs, and crisis intervention services. The agency administers grants for communities, states, and organizations addressing substance use disorders, mental health conditions, suicide prevention, and special populations including pregnant women, veterans, rural communities, and LGBTQ+ individuals.

## Key Topics

- 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
- FindTreatment.gov
- Mental Health Client-Level Data (MH-CLD)
- Evidence-based practices
- Substance use disorders
- Opioid treatment programs
- Buprenorphine treatment
- Recovery communities
- Medication-assisted treatment
- National Helpline
- Veterans Crisis Line
- Disaster Distress Helpline
- Grant funding opportunities
- Suicide prevention
- Employment and recovery

## Data Collections and Resources

- [Data Collections](https://www.samhsa.gov/data/data-we-collect): SAMHSA data collections including MH-CLD, MH-TEDS, and NSDUH surveys
- [Key Resources and Tools for MH-CLD | CBHSQ Data](https://www.samhsa.gov/data/data-we-collect/mh-cld-mental-health-client-level-data): Mental Health Client-Level Data resources, tools, and public use files

## Evidence-Based Practice Guidelines

- [Recommended Standard Care for People with Suicide Risk](https://www.samhsa.gov/resource/ebp/recommended-standard-care-people-suicide-risk): Clinical guidelines for standard care of individuals with suicide risk
- [Substance Use Disorders Recovery with a Focus on Employment](https://www.samhsa.gov/resource/ebp/substance-use-disorders-recovery-focus-employment): Evidence-based practice guide for substance use recovery and employment
- [A Drug Court Team Member's Guide to Medication in Addiction Treatment](https://www.samhsa.gov/resource/ebp/drug-court-team-members-guide-medication-addiction-treatment): Guide for drug court teams on medication-assisted addiction treatment

## Grant Funding Opportunities

- [Cooperative Agreements for States and Territories to Build Local 988 Capacity](https://www.samhsa.gov/grants/grant-announcements/sm-22-015): Grant to expand 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline state/territory capacity
- [Rural Opioid Technical Assistance Regional Centers](https://www.samhsa.gov/grants/grant-announcements/ti-22-012): Grant for rural opioid/stimulant technical assistance regional centers
- [Building Communities of Recovery](https://www.samhsa.gov/grants/grant-announcements/TI-21-004): FY 2021 grant announcement for Building Communities of Recovery (BCOR)
- [State Pilot Grant Program for Treatment for Pregnant and Postpartum Women](https://www.samhsa.gov/grants/grant-announcements/ti-21-002): FY 2021 grant for pregnant and postpartum women treatment programs
- [Statewide Consumer Network Grant Program](https://www.samhsa.gov/grants/grant-announcements/sm-22-009): Grant for statewide consumer-run mental health recovery organizations

## News and Awareness

- [SAMHSA Recognizes Posttraumatic Stress Disorder Awareness Month](https://www.samhsa.gov/blog/posttraumatic-stress-disorder-awareness-month): PTSD Awareness Month recognition and trauma support resources
